2607.08317.title: Blind-Spots-Bench: Evaluating Blind Spots in Multimodal Models
2607.08317.paper_summary: Modern AI models achieve strong performance on many established benchmarks, yet they still fail on tasks that humans find almost trivial, such as manipulating a string or drawing a dog with five legs. These examples suggest that existing benchmarks may under-measure persistent blind spots in current systems. We introduce $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$, a benchmark designed to expose such blind spots through tasks that appear simple for humans but remain challenging for modern AI. We collect raw questions from students in an AI course, clean and annotate them with structured reference solutions, and propose a task taxonomy tailored to the resulting dataset of 235 samples. We further develop an automated grading pipeline to evaluate a wide range of models, including open-weight and closed-source language, vision-language, and image-generation models. Our analysis on $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$ reveals that closed-source frontier models can substantially outperform open-weight models with even $\approx10\%$ gap, even when they attain comparable performance on existing benchmarks. A more fine-grained analysis shows that no single model dominates across all task types, and that some tasks remain challenging for all evaluated models. These results highlight the value of $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$ as a diagnostic stress test for identifying concrete weaknesses in current modern models.
2607.08317.paper_summary_zh: 現代的人工智慧模型在許多既定基準上表現出色，然而它們在一些人類認為幾乎微不足道的任務上仍然失敗，例如操作一個字符串或畫一隻有五條腿的狗。這些例子表明，現有的基準可能低估了當前系統中的持續盲點。我們介紹了 $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$，這是一個旨在通過對人類來說看似簡單但對現代人工智慧仍然具有挑戰性的任務來揭示這些盲點的基準。我們從人工智慧課程的學生中收集原始問題，對其進行清理並使用結構化的參考解決方案進行註釋，並提出了一個針對235個樣本的數據集量身定制的任務分類法。我們進一步開發了一個自動評分管道，以評估各種模型，包括開放權重和封閉源的語言、視覺語言和圖像生成模型。我們對 $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$ 的分析顯示，封閉源的前沿模型可以顯著超越開放權重模型，甚至存在約10%的差距，即使它們在現有基準上達到可比的性能。更細緻的分析顯示，沒有任何單一模型在所有任務類型中佔主導地位，並且一些任務對所有評估的模型來說仍然具有挑戰性。這些結果突顯了 $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$ 作為診斷壓力測試的價值，用於識別當前現代模型中的具體弱點。
